Controlled disposal · Romania

Beach evacuated as explosive drone fragment detonated at Olimp, Romania

26 August 2026 · Olimp beach

Confirmed explosive-drone fragment; origin unresolved

On 26 August 2026 a drone fragment containing explosive material was found on the tourist beach at Olimp, Constanța County, Romania. The beach was evacuated, access was restricted, a cordon was set up, and an RO-Alert warning was issued.

Specialists from the SRI Antiterrorist Brigade detonated the material on the beach in a controlled explosion. No casualties were reported.

The authorities had not announced the fragment’s origin or the drone model in reporting from 26–27 August, and the date and route of the original flight are unknown.
